models.name: Qwen3Guard
models.description: A multilingual guardrail model series with generative and streaming variants for prompt and response safety classification.
models.descriptionZh: 面向提示词与回复安全分类的多语言护栏模型系列，包含生成式与流式版本。
models.verificationNote: The official Qwen repository documents the model variants, safety-classification use, supported languages, and release links.

models.name: Llama Guard 3 8B
models.description: Meta's 8B safeguard model for classifying the safety of prompts and model responses.
models.descriptionZh: Meta 发布的 8B 安全防护模型，用于判断提示词与模型回复是否安全。
models.verificationNote: The official Meta model card identifies the model as a safeguard for prompt and response classification.

models.name: ShieldGemma 2 4B IT
models.description: A Gemma 3-based model for classifying image safety across sexually explicit, dangerous, and violence-related categories.
models.descriptionZh: 基于 Gemma 3 的图像安全分类模型，覆盖露骨内容、危险内容与暴力内容等类别。
models.verificationNote: Google's official model card and linked paper specify the architecture and image-safety categories.

models.name: WildGuard
models.description: A 7B open moderation model that classifies harmful prompts, harmful responses, and response refusals.
models.descriptionZh: 用于识别有害提示词、有害回复与回复拒绝情况的 7B 开放式内容审核模型。
models.verificationNote: The official AI2 model card and paper describe WildGuard as an open moderation model for prompts, responses, and refusals.

models.name: Granite Guardian 3.3 8B
models.description: IBM's 8B risk-detection model for prompt and response safety, jailbreaks, tool calls, and groundedness checks.
models.descriptionZh: IBM 发布的 8B 风险检测模型，覆盖提示词与回复安全、越狱、工具调用及有据性检查。
models.verificationNote: IBM's official model card, repository, and paper document the supported risk-detection tasks and release.

models.name: Aegis Safety Guard 7B — Permissive
models.description: NVIDIA's 7B content-safety model for classifying user prompts and assistant responses across thirteen safety categories.
models.descriptionZh: NVIDIA 发布的 7B 内容安全模型，用于按 13 类安全风险判断用户提示词和助手回复。
models.verificationNote: NVIDIA's official model card and Aegis paper document the thirteen-category safety taxonomy and prompt-response classification task.

models.name: Foundation-Sec-8B
models.description: Cisco's open-weight 8B base language model specialized for cybersecurity applications.
models.descriptionZh: Cisco 发布的 8B 开放权重基础语言模型，专门面向网络安全应用。
models.verificationNote: Cisco's release announcement and official model card describe the model as an open-weight cybersecurity-specialized base model.

models.name: DeBERTa-v3 Prompt Injection Detector v2
models.description: A 0.2B English classifier for distinguishing benign inputs from prompt-injection attacks; its official model card marks it archived and no longer maintained.
models.descriptionZh: 用于区分正常输入与提示注入攻击的 0.2B 英文分类器；官方模型卡已标注该模型归档且不再维护。
models.verificationNote: Protect AI's official model card specifies the classification task, model size, English-only scope, and archived status.

models.name: Beaver-7B-v2.0
models.description: A 7B model released by PKU-Alignment from its Safe-RLHF work on safer alignment with human feedback.
models.descriptionZh: PKU-Alignment 在 Safe-RLHF 工作中发布的 7B 模型，用于研究更安全的人类反馈对齐。
models.verificationNote: The official PKU-Alignment repository and model card connect Beaver-7B-v2.0 to the Safe-RLHF project.

models.name: Beaver-7B-v3.0
models.description: A later Beaver 7B release from PKU-Alignment's Safe-RLHF project for studying safer alignment with human feedback.
models.descriptionZh: PKU-Alignment 在 Safe-RLHF 项目中发布的后续 7B Beaver 模型，用于研究更安全的人类反馈对齐。
models.verificationNote: The official PKU-Alignment model card and repository identify Beaver-7B-v3.0 as a Safe-RLHF model release.

models.name: Llama Guard 4
models.description: A 12B natively multimodal safety classifier pruned from Llama 4 Scout and fine-tuned for prompt/response content-safety classification across text and multi-image inputs.
models.descriptionZh: 12B 原生多模态安全分类模型，从 Llama 4 Scout 剪枝并微调，用于文本与多图输入的提示词/回复内容安全分类。
models.verificationNote: Official Hugging Face model card for meta-llama/Llama-Guard-4-12B documents the multimodal safety-classifier role; HF blog corroborates the release. Added from issue #30.

models.name: Llama Prompt Guard 2 86M
models.description: 86M multilingual prompt-injection and jailbreak classifier in Meta's Prompt Guard 2 series for detecting adversarial prompts before they reach an LLM.
models.descriptionZh: Meta Prompt Guard 2 系列中的 86M 多语种提示注入与越狱分类器，用于在提示到达 LLM 前检测对抗性提示。
models.verificationNote: Official HF model card meta-llama/Llama-Prompt-Guard-2-86M (created 2025-04-28) documents the Prompt Guard 2 86M safety classifier role; GitHub meta-llama/llama-models resolves. Not present in OpenTAI ecosystem-catalog models as of 2026-09-20. Added from issue #34.

models.name: Prompt-Guard-86M
models.description: Meta Prompt Guard 86M text classifier for detecting prompt injections and jailbreaks in LLM application inputs.
models.descriptionZh: Meta Prompt Guard 86M 文本分类器，用于检测 LLM 应用中的提示注入与越狱。
models.verificationNote: Official HF model card meta-llama/Prompt-Guard-86M resolves with high download volume; documents prompt-injection/jailbreak classification. Not present under Prompt-Guard naming in OpenTAI ecosystem-catalog models as of 2026-09-20. Added from issue #35.

models.name: Llama Guard 2
models.description: Llama Guard 2 8B input/output safety classifier for human-AI conversations, labeling prompts and responses into safety risk categories.
models.descriptionZh: Llama Guard 2 8B 人机对话输入/输出安全分类器，对提示与回复进行安全标签。
models.verificationNote: Official HF model card meta-llama/Meta-Llama-Guard-2-8B resolves; Meta Llama Guard research page corroborates the safeguard role. OpenTAI catalog has Llama Guard 3/4 but not Guard 2 as of 2026-09-20. Added from issue #36.

models.name: ShieldLM
models.description: LLM-based safety detector (EMNLP 2024 Findings) that judges query-response safety with customizable and explainable decisions (EN/ZH).
models.descriptionZh: 基于 LLM 的安全检测器（EMNLP 2024 Findings），可按可定制规则判定查询-回复安全性。
models.verificationNote: arXiv:2402.16444 and GitHub thu-coai/ShieldLM resolve; HF thu-coai/ShieldLM-7B-internlm2 documents the safety-detector role. Not in OpenTAI ecosystem-catalog models as of 2026-09-20. Added from issue #37.

models.name: MD-Judge
models.description: Safety judge model released with SALAD-Bench for evaluating LLM responses against hierarchical safety taxonomies.
models.descriptionZh: 随 SALAD-Bench 发布的安全评判模型，用于按分层安全分类评估 LLM 回复。
models.verificationNote: HF OpenSafetyLab/MD-Judge-v0.1 resolves; SALAD-Bench paper arXiv:2402.05044 and GitHub OpenSafetyLab/SALAD-BENCH identify MD-Judge as the official safety evaluator. Not in OpenTAI ecosystem-catalog models as of 2026-09-20. Added from issue #38.

models.name: Shieldstral 1.0 3B
models.description: Mistral Shieldstral 1.0 3B safety/guard model for content policy classification and moderation.
models.descriptionZh: Mistral Shieldstral 1.0 3B 安全/护栏模型，用于内容策略分类与审核。
models.verificationNote: Official HF model card mistralai/Shieldstral-1.0-3B (created 2026-07-16) resolves and identifies the guard/safety role. Not in OpenTAI ecosystem-catalog models as of 2026-09-20. Added from issue #39.

models.name: Granite Guardian 4.1 8B
models.description: IBM Granite Guardian 4.1 8B risk detector for prompts and responses in enterprise LLM applications.
models.descriptionZh: IBM Granite Guardian 4.1 8B 风险检测器，面向企业 LLM 应用中的提示与回复。
models.verificationNote: HF ibm-granite/granite-guardian-4.1-8b (created 2026-04-16) and GitHub ibm-granite/granite-guardian resolve. OpenTAI catalog lists Granite Guardian 3.3 8B but not 4.1 as of 2026-09-20. Added from issue #40.

models.name: Llama-3.1-Nemotron-Safety-Guard-8B-v3
models.description: NVIDIA Nemotron multilingual LLM content-safety guard (Llama 3.1 8B backbone) for prompt/response risk classification.
models.descriptionZh: NVIDIA Nemotron 多语种 LLM 内容安全护栏（Llama 3.1 8B 骨干），用于提示/回复风险检测。
models.verificationNote: Official HF card nvidia/Llama-3.1-Nemotron-Safety-Guard-8B-v3 (created 2025-08-20) documents multilingual content-safety guard use. Not in OpenTAI ecosystem-catalog models as of 2026-09-20. Added from issue #41.

models.name: GuardReasoner-8B
models.description: Reasoning-based LLM safeguard model trained with R-SFT on GuardReasonerTrain for explainable safety judgments.
models.descriptionZh: 基于推理的 LLM 护栏模型，在 GuardReasonerTrain 上经 R-SFT 训练，提供可解释的安全判定。
models.verificationNote: HF yueliu1999/GuardReasoner-8B and GitHub yueliu1999/GuardReasoner resolve; paper arXiv:2501.18492 describes reasoning-based safeguards. Not in OpenTAI ecosystem-catalog models as of 2026-09-20. Added from issue #42.

models.name: BeaverDam-7B
models.description: PKU-Alignment moderation/cost model for scoring QA harmfulness, companion to BeaverTails and Safe-RLHF.
models.descriptionZh: PKU-Alignment 审核/代价模型，用于对问答有害性打分，配合 BeaverTails 与 Safe-RLHF。
models.verificationNote: HF PKU-Alignment/beaver-dam-7b resolves; Safe-RLHF/BeaverTails project (arXiv:2307.04657, GitHub PKU-Alignment/safe-rlhf) identifies BeaverDam as the moderation model. Landmark companion to on-site BeaverTails; not in OpenTAI models catalog as of 2026-09-20. Added from issue #43.

models.name: AgentDoG
models.description: Diagnostic guardrail / agent-safety alignment model family (AgentDoG 1.0/1.5) for classifying and mitigating unsafe agent trajectories.
models.descriptionZh: 诊断式护栏 / 智能体安全对齐模型系列（AgentDoG 1.0/1.5），用于分类并缓解不安全的智能体轨迹。
models.verificationNote: HF AI45Research/AgentDoG-Qwen3-4B (+ family), GitHub AI45Lab/AgentDoG, arXiv:2601.18491 / 2605.29801 resolve. Open weights for agent safety guardrails. Not on Models page or Model Issues. Added from issue #73.

models.name: HomeGuard
models.description: VLM-based embodied safeguard (HomeGuard-8B) for identifying contextual/implicit risks in household robot tasks.
models.descriptionZh: 基于 VLM 的具身护栏（HomeGuard-8B），用于识别家务机器人任务中的情境/隐性风险。
models.verificationNote: HF Ursulalala/HomeGuard-8B, GitHub AI45Lab/HomeGuard, arXiv:2603.14367 (ECCV 2026) resolve. Embodied safety model weights released. Not on Models page or Model Issues. Added from issue #74.

models.name: X-Boundary
models.description: Defense method/models that learn an exact safety boundary in representation space to resist multi-turn jailbreaks while preserving usability; public LoRA adapters released.
models.descriptionZh: 在表示空间学习精确安全边界的防御方法/模型，在保持可用性的同时抵抗多轮越狱；公开发布 LoRA 适配器。
models.verificationNote: GitHub AI45Lab/X-Boundary, arXiv:2502.09990 (EMNLP 2025), HF collection Ursulalala/x-boundary with adapters (e.g. X-Boundary-Llama-3-8B-adapter) resolve. Not on Models page or Model Issues. Added from issue #75.

models.name: SafeVLA
models.description: Safety-aligned Vision-Language-Action models via constrained learning to reduce unsafe embodied actions while preserving task success.
models.descriptionZh: 通过约束学习得到的安全对齐视觉-语言-动作模型，在保持任务成功率的同时减少不安全具身动作。
models.verificationNote: GitHub PKU-Alignment/SafeVLA, arXiv:2503.03480 (NeurIPS 2025 Spotlight), HF SafetyEmbodiedAI/safety-model resolve. Embodied safety-aligned VLA model release. Not on Models page or Model Issues. Added from issue #76.

models.name: BraveGuard
models.description: Family of trajectory-level safety guard models for computer-use agents. Judges full multi-step agent trajectories (actions, tool calls, intermediate reasoning, side effects) rather than isolated prompts/responses. Public checkpoints include Qwen3-Guard 4B/8B and Llama-Guard-8B variants under the BraveGuard HF repo; MIT-licensed training/eval framework on GitHub.
models.descriptionZh: 面向计算机使用智能体的轨迹级安全护栏模型族，对完整多步轨迹（动作、工具调用、中间推理与副作用）而非单条提示/回复做安全判定；公开权重含 Qwen3-Guard 与 Llama-Guard 变体。
models.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-09-20: GitHub Yunhao-Feng/BraveGuard (public, MIT), HF Yunhao-Feng/BraveGuard, arXiv:2606.01166. Classified as Model (Guard Models / Agents). Added from issue #79.

models.name: HazardAuditor
models.description: ~8B generative guard (based on Qwen3Guard-Gen-8B) that audits complete computer-use agent trajectories—request, reasoning, tool calls/args, and outcomes—and returns an evidence-grounded rationale plus a binary safe/unsafe verdict. Trained with SFT and GuardPO for execution-level agent safety auditing across heterogeneous agent frameworks.
models.descriptionZh: 约 8B 生成式护栏（基于 Qwen3Guard-Gen-8B），审计计算机使用智能体的完整轨迹（请求、推理、工具调用与结果），输出证据化理由与 safe/unsafe 判定。
models.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-09-20: GitHub/HF Yunhao-Feng/HazardAuditor, arXiv:2609.15134. Distinct from HazardArena benchmark (#84). Added from issue #80.

models.name: SentGuard
models.description: Sentence-level streaming guardrail for LLMs that buffers streamed tokens into sentence chunks, verifies each chunk in parallel with continued decoding, and releases only verified text. Trained with a coarse-to-fine objective on StreamSafe (per-sentence annotations over 8 harm categories). Based on Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507; Apache-2.0 safetensors release on HF.
models.descriptionZh: 面向 LLM 的句级流式护栏：将流式 token 缓冲为句子块、并行校验并只释放已验证文本；在 StreamSafe 上以粗到细目标训练，基于 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507。
models.publisher: Jiaqi Yu, Xin Wang, Yixu Wang, Jie Li, Yan Teng, Xingjun Ma, Yingchun Wang (Fudan University & Shanghai AI Laboratory)
models.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-09-20: arXiv:2606.02041; HF Solitude0630/SentGuard (no public GitHub located). Added from issue #81 with HF as primary artifact.

models.name: ML-Guard
models.description: Diffusion LLM (dLLM)-based multilingual safety guardrail with policy-conditioned compliance assessment. Two variants: ML-Guard-1.5B for fast safe/unsafe classification (latency-sensitive), and ML-Guard-7B for customized policy compliance checking with violated rules and rationales. Built on and evaluated with ML-Bench (14 languages).
models.descriptionZh: 基于扩散 LLM（dLLM）的多语种安全护栏，支持政策条件化合规评估：1.5B 做快速 safe/unsafe 判定，7B 做带违规规则与解释的定制化合规检查；配套 ML-Bench（14 种语言）。
models.publisher: Yunhan Zhao, Zhaorun Chen, Xingjun Ma, Yu-Gang Jiang, Bo Li (UIUC, Fudan, UChicago)
models.verificationNote: Primary source checked 2026-09-20: arXiv:2605.00689. No public GitHub/HF weights located; arXiv-primary listing. Companion benchmark ML-Bench (#82). Unrelated to gersteinlab/ML-Bench. Added from issue #83.

models.name: BioSafe-Guard
models.description: Inference-time input guard for protein/toxin-design prompts: BioLinkBERT-large (340M) binary classifier fine-tuned on 300 toxin + 300 benign prompts (disjoint from 631 SPIKE-Bench eval prompts). Flags unsafe toxin-design requests before generation; paper reports FHR ≤0.5% across 32 models with ~1% benign over-refusal.
models.descriptionZh: 面向蛋白质/毒素设计提示的推理时输入护栏：基于 BioLinkBERT-large（340M）的二分类器，在 300 条毒素 + 300 条良性提示上微调（与 631 条 SPIKE-Bench 评测提示不相交）；在生成前拦截不安全的毒素设计请求，论文报告在 32 个模型上 FHR ≤0.5%，良性过拒约 1%。
models.verificationNote: Primary sources checked 2026-09-21: arXiv:2608.02684; HF quanshu01/BioSafe-Guard; GitHub PKU-Alignment/SPIKE-Bench. Guard Models / LLMs. Companion SPIKE-Bench (#86). Added from issue #87.

frameworks.name: OpenRT
frameworks.description: An open-source red-teaming framework for multimodal large language models with black-box and white-box attacks across text and image inputs.
frameworks.descriptionZh: 面向多模态大语言模型的开源红队框架，支持文本与图像输入上的黑盒和白盒攻击。
frameworks.verificationNote: The official repository and paper describe OpenRT's supported modalities, access settings, and attack library.

frameworks.name: OpenART
frameworks.description: A research framework for scaling agent red teaming through open-ended environment evolution.
frameworks.descriptionZh: 通过开放式环境演化扩展智能体红队测试的研究框架。
frameworks.verificationNote: The official repository and paper consistently describe environment evolution for agent red teaming; the former project-page URL is excluded because it returns 404.

frameworks.name: Promptfoo
frameworks.description: An open-source toolkit for evaluating and red-teaming LLM applications, agents, and RAG systems in development and CI/CD workflows.
frameworks.descriptionZh: 用于评测与红队测试大模型应用、智能体和 RAG 系统的开源工具，可接入开发及 CI/CD 流程。
frameworks.verificationNote: Promptfoo's official repository and documentation cover evaluation, red teaming, supported application types, and CI/CD use.

frameworks.name: Safe-RLHF
frameworks.description: An open-source implementation for safer reinforcement learning from human feedback, including training code, datasets, and model releases.
frameworks.descriptionZh: 用于更安全的人类反馈强化学习的开源实现，包含训练代码、数据集和模型发布。
frameworks.verificationNote: The official repository provides the Safe-RLHF implementation and links its paper, datasets, and model releases.

arenas.name: Gray Swan Arena

arenas.descriptionZh: 面向对抗性 AI 研究的在线环境，通过定向挑战连接有激励机制的红队社区。

arenas.name: DTap
arenas.description: A controllable interactive red-teaming platform for AI agents with simulated environments and public benchmark results.

arenas.verificationNote: The official paper, platform, repository, and results page support the description; it is labeled Research Arena rather than a public competition leaderboard.

arenas.name: OpenART
arenas.description: A research arena for agent red teaming in which environments evolve to expose new failure modes.
arenas.descriptionZh: 用于智能体红队测试的研究型竞技环境，通过环境演化暴露新的失效模式。
